tools.name: net_worth_percentile
tools.description:
Where a net worth ranks among US families whose head is the same age group.

    Args:
        age: the person's age (18-110).
        net_worth: total assets minus total debts, in US dollars (can be negative).

tools.name: net_worth_by_age
tools.description:
Median, average and top-percentile net worth for US families by age.

    Args:
        age: optional. Give an age for that age group's full breakdown
            (percentiles, homeowners vs renters); omit it for every age group.

tools.name: retirement_savings_needed
tools.description:
How much someone needs saved to retire at an age and spend a yearly amount.

    Args:
        retirement_age: age at retirement (40-80).
        annual_spending: all-in yearly spending in today's dollars (5,000-1,000,000).

tools.name: retirement_income_from_savings
tools.description:
How much a nest egg can sustainably pay out per year from a retirement age to 95.

    Args:
        savings: total retirement savings in US dollars (10,000-50,000,000).
        retirement_age: age at retirement (40-80).
